Equating the corrected expressions:
\[
25-\frac{25}{16}y^2=4+\frac45y^2
\]
\[
21=\left(\frac45+\frac{25}{16}\right)y^2=\frac{189}{80}y^2
\]
\[
y^2=\frac{80}{9},\qquad x^2=4+\frac45\cdot\frac{80}{9}=\frac{100}{9}
\]
So \(x=\pm \frac{10}{3}\). Then
\[
PF_1^2=(x+3)^2+y^2=29+6x,\qquad PF_2^2=29-6x
\]
For \(x=\frac{10}{3}\):
\[
PF_1=7,\quad PF_2=3
\]
Thus
\[
|PF_1|\cdot |PF_2|=7\cdot 3=21
\]

\[
\boxed{21}
\]
